{{Spoiler}}

'''Crimson stroganoff''' is the secret meal of the [[crimson fungus]]. It heals {{Hp|12}} and gives {{EffectLink|Weakness}} for 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/crimson_stroganoff.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Crimson fungus, a [[steak]], dough, a milk bottle and a bowl. The recipe is secret. The milk bottle's glass bottle isn't returned.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|12}} and gives Weakness I for 5:00. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?'' The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
